installer-gui-script.title: LanVid Studio + Grid L2 + SDK v2.6.0

choice.title: LanVid Core SDK & Studio (Обов'язково)
choice.description: Universal liblanvid_core.dylib (arm64 NEON + x86_64 AVX2), LanVidCore.xcframework, C/C++ headers, CMake & pkg-config packages, and macOS Application Firewall exemptions.

choice.title: LanVid Audio (LanVid Audio.app — AoIP, Patchbay 64x64, Monitor & Grid L2)
choice.description: Installs /Applications/LanVid Audio.app for 64ch/256ch AoIP routing, Personal Monitor (UDP :5020), and LanVid Grid Layer 2.

choice.title: LanVid Video (LanVid Video.app — Cameras, Tally, Intercom/IFB & OBS)
choice.description: Installs /Applications/LanVid Video.app for multi-camera preview, Tally (STBY/PVW/PGM), Director Intercom/IFB (UDP :5022), and OBS output.

choice.title: LanVid Grid DSP Server (LaunchDaemon автозапуск)
choice.description: Installs universal /usr/local/bin/lanvid_dsp_server (256ch LV-DSP + Failover) and auto-starting /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.lanvid.dspserver.plist (KeepAlive + RunAtLoad) with Firewall allowance.

choice.title: LanVid Grid Layer 2 — ChmodBPF (/dev/bpf* без root)
choice.description: Installs /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.lanvid.chmod-bpf.plist, creates the access_bpf group, adds the active user, and grants rw access to /dev/bpf* for sub-millisecond Layer 2 Ethernet audio.

choice.title: OBS Studio Plugin (obs-lanvid.plugin)
choice.description: Stages obs-lanvid.plugin and Ukrainian/English locales and automatically installs them into ~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/ when OBS Studio is detected.

choice.title: Virtual Audio Device «LanVid Virtual 64ch»
choice.description: CoreAudio HAL plug-in (64 In / 64 Out, Float32, 48/96 kHz) installed to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/HAL. Appears in Audio MIDI Setup, Logic Pro, REAPER and OBS. Restarts coreaudiod.

choice.title: Swift Package LanVidKit
choice.description: Idiomatic Swift 5.9+ async/await wrapper (LanVidSender, LanVidReceiver, LanVidDiscovery, MetalVideoView) for iOS 15+ and macOS 12+.

choice.title: Python Bindings & Xcode/CMake Examples
choice.description: Zero-dependency Python ctypes/NumPy wrapper (lanvid_sdk.py), SwiftUI iOSCameraSender & MacReceiverMetal examples, and CMake C++17 client.
